provenance_policy: Strict Real-Data Separation (No synthetic data labeled as real)

real_industrial_ocr.recommended_source: MVTec Industrial Text / Scanned Public Technical Reports (e.g. NASA NTRS technical reports or OSHA incident reports)

real_engineering_pdf.target_task: Native PDF Extraction vs OCR Routing Accuracy
real_engineering_pdf.recommended_source: Public OSHA / Chemical Safety Board (CSB) Investigation Reports (clean native digital PDFs with known text layers)

real_rag_qa_benchmark.target_task: Technical Knowledge Retrieval & Grounded QA (Recall@k, MRR, Citation Completeness)
real_rag_qa_benchmark.recommended_source: Public CSB Investigation Reports with curated Q&A pairs and ground-truth page citations

real_industrial_vision.recommended_source: OpenGauge Dataset / Roboflow Industrial Pointer Meter Dataset (real photographic captures under varied lighting and angles)
real_industrial_vision.ground_truth_format: Bounding box + ground-truth numerical reading / text

local_synthetic_fixtures.target_task: Regression & Security Gate Unit Testing (NOT valid for real-data benchmark metrics)
local_synthetic_fixtures.source: Programmatic generation (PIL, FPDF, ReportLab) in CogniShift repo
